telegram_contract.non_mpeg4_video_policy: Treat current WebM gallery assets as not proven native-video-ready. Telegram documents that other formats may be sent as Document; do not silently downgrade a planned video post into a document.

preferred_canary_transport.reason: The first canary should exercise the smallest reviewed mutation surface. Exact source bytes are preferred over a drifting URL fetch, and a photo avoids the current WebM/native-video compatibility question.

blocking_checks: materialize exact source blob bytes from the pinned Milovi_Cake commit
verify decoded width and height satisfy Bot API photo limits
verify decoded format is accepted as a photo by the selected upload path
compute and freeze a byte-level SHA-256 for the materialized canary file

video_policy.required_next_step: Create a separate deterministic video conversion/readiness lane before any WebM-backed slot is approved as a native Telegram video payload. Preserve the source media identity and verify the resulting MP4 dimensions, duration, codec, size and output digest.
